newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Bufete started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bufete started as buy.

text.p: An analyst at Grupo Financiero Serfin said on Tuesday that they started coverage of Mexican construction company Bufete Industrial with a buy recommendation.
Analyst Gerardo Saenz estimated a loss per share of 1.78 pesos in 1996 which would revert to an earnings per share of 1.54 pesos in 1997 as projects in the pipeline increase.

"We like Bufete because of its strong presence in the infrastructure industry of Mexico and in other Latin countries, its considerable possibilities for growth as a leading construction company and because of its (recent) refinancing of short-term debt," Saenz said in a report.

He estimated incomes would rise 58 and 28 percent in 1996 and 1997. "The company should benefit from important contracts...and projects such as water treatment plants, energy plants and urban works," he added.
